notes:
- Fix precision BPM mode reading just short of the tempo range at the ends of the tempo fader. At ±6, ±10 and ±16 the fader ends now give the full range, and whole BPM values just inside an end still catch.
- Fix the stems "S" mark missing from tracks that have prepared stems when the USB's rekordbox libraries number the same track differently. Stems already prepared keep working; nothing needs to be separated again.
- Show the stems "S" mark in the Load Previous Track list.
- Fix Beat Jump during a held Gate Cue Hot Cue started from pause leaving the deck playing after the pad is released. Releasing the pad now returns to the Hot Cue, paused.
- The held Hot Cue pad now flashes while Gate Cue is auditioning it, at the same rate as the flashing CUE button.
